subject: Cerulean Systems — pilot bundle + credits (exec approval needed)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Holmes <emily.holmes@ceruleansystems.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot bundle proposal — 60-day extension + credits

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for the demo earlier today — really enjoyed walking through the latency and routing controls with your infra team. Per our conversation, I put together a short proposal to keep Cerulean's evaluation momentum going while procurement finishes the legal review.

Proposal (pilot bundle):
- Extend trial window from 30 -> 90 days (one-time extension)
- $30,000 in free inference credits applied to the account during the pilot
- One waived onboarding session (normally $5k) and dedicated weekly CSM office hours for the first 6 weeks
- Optional pilot SLO: 99.5% uptime priority on our shared capacity pool for the pilot duration

I've attached a draft SOW and a simple cost model showing projected token consumption for your 3 top workloads. If Cerulean signs off, we can push a DocuSign SOW and activate the credits within 24 hours.

Two quick asks for your side: 1) confirmation of the production timelines you shared (Q4 target?) and 2) a primary procurement contact to route the SOW.

Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Jonas
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: Cerulean_SOW_draft_v1.pdf, pilot-cost-model.xlsx

From: Emily Holmes <emily.holmes@ceruleansystems.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T11:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot bundle proposal — 60-day extension + credits

Jonas —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and clear proposal. This looks promising. A few notes from our side after reviewing with Rajiv (CFO) and our infra lead:
- We need the pilot window to be 90 days (you said 90 in the call; proposal says 60 — 90 works for us)
- Can you stretch the credits to $40k? The token burn on our longest prompt is higher than estimated and we'd like to test a larger slice of traffic
- Procurement wants a small guaranteed discount if we convert to a committed contract (we suggested 20% for year one)

Procurement contact: procurement@ceruleansystems.com (cc'd).

Can you route this back to your leadership for a combined approval (credits + discount + extended pilot)? If we can get that signoff this week we can move quickly.

Thanks,
Emily
Head of ML Platforms | Cerulean Systems
emily.holmes@ceruleansystems.com

Quoted attachment: security questionnaire was attached on our side.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: me
Date: 2027-05-05T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Cerulean Systems — pilot bundle + credits (exec signoff needed)

Marissa / Steph —

Forwarding Cerulean's ask. Summary: they want a 90-day trial, $40k in free credits, and a 20% first-year conversion discount if they sign a committed agreement. They are mid-market, strong vertical fit (healthcare analytics partner list), and procurement is ready to move fast. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/ceru-058

Why this matters (TL;DR):
- Potential ARR if converted: ~$1.2M over 3 years (FS forecast)
- High referenceability in our target industry (Cerulean is well-regarded in insurance analytics)
- They completed the basic security questionnaire and asked for SOC evidence; their security team will push on KMS/HSM later, but not blocking the pilot

Suggested approval ask (recommended):
- Approve 90-day pilot extension (standard ask: okay)
- Approve $30k free credits now, with the option to top up to $40k if they hit pre-agreed eval milestones (e.g., 2 model pipelines ingesting >200k tokens/day)
- Approve a performance-based conversion discount: up to 20% in year one but capped at 15% guaranteed; escalate to 20% if a volume threshold is hit within 90 days
- Waive onboarding fee and allocate a dedicated CSM for the pilot

Attached: draft SOW and pilot cost model. Pricing impact: $30k immediate credit burn (expected), potential revenue loss up to 15% on first-year ARR if they convert at the discounted rate.

Asking for a quick yes/no so I can reply to procurement this morning.

—Jonas

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-05T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Cerulean Systems — pilot bundle + credits (exec signoff needed)

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear summary. I think this is strategically sound but want tighter guardrails on approvals. Two comments:
1) Approve $30k credit upfront. If they request top-up to $40k, require a milestone (as you suggested) and have finance pre-authorize one-time top-up subject to a 30-day usage review.
2) Discount: approve up to 15% guaranteed for year one if they convert within 120 days. Approve up to 20% only if they hit a firm volume threshold (we should define it in the SOW).

Please add a clause that any SOW with discounts >15% requires CFO countersign (I'll loop finance). Also ensure the security artifact checklist is completed before credits are activated.

If you can update the SOW with those conditions, I'm comfortable giving conditional exec approval.

-Marissa
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

(Attachment: pilot-cost-model.xlsx reviewed)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Holmes <emily.holmes@ceruleansystems.com>, procurement@ceruleansystems.com
Date: 2027-05-07T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cerulean Systems — pilot bundle + credits (exec approval needed)

Perfect, thanks Marissa. I'll update the SOW with the milestone/top-up language and add the discount threshold clause. Quick notes so procurement has visibility:
- Upfront: $30k credits activated on pilot start after security artifact checklist OK
- Top-up: additional $10k unlocked automatically if they hit >200k tokens/day on two pipelines for a 3-day window (measured by our telemetry)
- Discount: 15% guaranteed for year one; 20% only if conversion within first 90 days and committed volume > $500k ARR in year one
- Finance countersign clause included for any >15% discounts

Links: HubSpot deal and draft DocuSign SOW above. I'll push the revised SOW to DocuSign and loop Rajiv if needed.

Emily / procurement — if these conditions work for you, I'll circulate the updated DocuSign SOW today and we can enable the credits on signature + completed security checklist.

Thanks,
Jonas

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T17:26:00-07:00
Subject: Approved: Cerulean pilot bundle (conditional)

Jonas —

Conditional exec approval granted. Approvals:
- $30k pilot credit now (activate on signature + security checklist completion)
- Potential $10k top-up per the milestone defined (>200k tokens/day across two pipelines for 3 days)
- Discount: 15% guaranteed for year one; escalation to 20% requires conversion within 90 days and >$500k ARR year-one threshold plus CFO countersign (Rajiv)

Conditions to enforce before activation:
1) Completed security artifact checklist and SOC evidence stub uploaded to our compliance portal
2) Signed DocuSign SOW with the milestone and finance countersign clause

Jonas, please move forward with updated SOW and loop finance for final countersign. Good job on keeping this tight — encourage the team to track the milestone triggers in the pilot dashboard so we can audit the top-up objectively.

-Marissa
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

On behalf of Redwood Inference leadership
